query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.id) o.id AS "orphan!", t.id AS "twin!" FROM series o JOIN series t ON replace(t.normalized_title, ' ', '') = replace(o.normalized_title, ' ', '') AND t.normalized_title = o.normalized_title AND t.id <> o.id WHERE o.normalized_title <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_sources x WHERE x.series_id = o.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_sources x WHERE x.series_id = t.id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sync_mappings mo JOIN sync_mappings mt ON mt.provider = mo.provider AND mt.series_id = t.id WHERE mo.series_id = o.id AND mo.provider = 'anilist' AND mo.external_id <> mt.external_id) ORDER BY o.id, (SELECT count(*) FROM series_sources x WHERE x.series_id = t.id) DESC, t.id LIMIT $1
